[[File:Mathematische_Annalen_1869_Titel.jpg | thumb | right | alt=Scan of Book "Mathematische Annalen" from 1869 | Scan of Book "Mathematische Annalen" from 1869]]
'''''Mathematische Annalen''''' (abbreviated as ''Math. Ann.'' or, formerly, ''Math. Annal.'') is a [[German language|German]] mathematical [[research journal]] founded in 1868 by [[Alfred Clebsch]] and [[Carl Neumann]]. Subsequent managing editors were [[Felix Klein]], [[David Hilbert]], [[Otto Blumenthal]], [[Erich Hecke]], [[Heinrich Behnke]], [[Hans Grauert]], [[Heinz Bauer]], [[Herbert Amann]], [[Jean-Pierre Bourguignon]], [[Wolfgang Lück]], [[Nigel Hitchin]], and [[Thomas Schick]].<ref name="behnke">{{cite journal | last=Behnke | first=Heinrich | author-link=Heinrich Behnke | title=Rückblick auf die Geschichte der Mathematischen Annalen | language=de | journal=<abbr title="Mathematische Annalen">Math. Ann.</abbr> | volume=200 | issue=1 | pages=i–vii | date=March 1973 | url=http://resolver.sub.uni-goettingen.de/purl?GDZPPN002307006 | doi=10.1007/BF01578287 | mr=0321664 | zbl = 0244.00001 }}</ref> Currently, the managing editor of Mathematische Annalen is Yoshikazu Giga ([[University of Tokyo]]).

Volumes 1–80 (1869–1919) were published by [[Bibliotheca Teubneriana|Teubner]]. Since 1920 (<abbr title="volume">vol.</abbr> 81), the journal has been published by [[Springer Science+Business Media|Springer]]. In the late 1920s, under the editorship of Hilbert, the journal became embroiled in controversy over the participation of [[L. E. J. Brouwer]] on its editorial board, a spillover from the foundational [[Brouwer–Hilbert controversy]].<ref>{{cite journal | last=van Dalen | first=D. | author-link = Dirk van Dalen | title=The war of the frogs and the mice, or the crisis of the ''Mathematische Annalen'' | journal=[[The Mathematical Intelligencer]] | volume=12 | issue=4 | pages=17–31 | date=December 1990 | doi=10.1007/BF03024028 | mr=1076531 | zbl = 0723.01006 }}</ref> Between 1945 and 1947, the journal briefly ceased publication.<ref name="behnke"/>
